kit.speaker: kit
kit.text: You're the new scout? Good. I'm only here because my uncle's in the militia and somebody had to carry the paper and ink. Colonel Washington wants eyes on the French.

washington.speaker: washington
washington.text: Scout. The French claim this whole valley and have built forts to hold it. Virginia claims it too. Find out how many are coming.

report.speaker: sivart
report.text: There are a lot of them. Way more than us.

report.speaker: washington
report.text: Then we hold this fort as long as we can.

kit_after.speaker: kit
kit_after.text: We lost. But Britain will send its army now. And armies cost money… somebody's going to have to pay for all this.

check_hint.speaker: senoj
check_hint.text: Look at the map. Whose color covers it now?
